name: A11y Book Reader
description: Accessible in-browser reader for EPUB, PDF, Word/PowerPoint (modern and 97-2003), OpenDocument, FB2, RTF, DAISY talking books, plain text/HTML, and Braille. Built to WCAG 2.2 A/AA: keyboard and TV-remote operable, screen-reader semantics, offline Piper neural text-to-speech with synced word highlighting, per-user resume across devices, and customizable display. Fully self-contained, no companion plugin required.
overview: Accessible WCAG 2.2 book and document reader with offline text-to-speech

versions.changelog: Self-contained: drops the File Transformation dependency via its own injection middleware. Adds Braille (.brf/.brl) reading with a print toggle and accurate UEB back-translation. Ships as one merged DLL.

name: Library Importer
description: Bulk-imports and manages movie/TV metadata from disk, TMDB, and TVDB. Supports scheduled scans, custom overrides, duplicate resolution, and orphan purging.
overview: Import and manage library metadata from disk, TMDB, and TVDB

versions.changelog: JSON type-safety fixes, quiet persistence, skip fast-path for movies+TV, config page improvements

name: A11y-Custom Tabs
description: Accessibility fork of Custom Tabs. Adds WCAG 2.2 A/AA fixes and TV remote focus support to custom sidebar tabs in Jellyfin.
overview: Custom sidebar tabs with WCAG 2.2 accessibility improvements

versions.changelog: A11y fork: WCAG 2.2 A/AA fixes, TV remote focus highlight, tab creation fix for emby-button Custom Elements

name: A11y-BetterSeerrTabs
description: Accessibility fork of BetterSeerrTabs. Adds WCAG 2.2 A/AA fixes and TV remote support to the Jellyseerr request integration.
overview: Jellyseerr request tabs with WCAG 2.2 accessibility improvements

versions.changelog: A11y fork: WCAG 2.2 A/AA fixes, TV remote support for injected UI

name: Audiobook Metadata Provider
description: Provides Audible metadata and cover art for AudioBook items via the Audnexus API.
overview: Audnexus-powered audiobook metadata and cover art

versions.changelog: Initial release: Audnexus API client replacing Audible scraper, audiobook image provider

name: Bookshelf
description: Provides metadata for book and comic libraries via Google Books, ComicVine, and Open Library.
overview: Book and comic metadata from Google Books, ComicVine, and Open Library

name: Audio Description Badges
description: Displays a visual and screen-reader-accessible badge on library cards for media that contains an Audio Description audio track. WCAG 2.2 compliant: 7.5:1 contrast ratio, role="img" + aria-label, Windows High Contrast Mode support, polite ARIA live region, reduced-motion support.
overview: WCAG 2.2 compliant Audio Description badges on Jellyfin library cards
